note: Today for you, on Care. One suggestion per time slot, picked by date so it stays the same all day. Short, warm, plain English, no medical claims. target: breathe, ground, journal, or guide:<guide id>. Set verified to true only after Najwa has checked the wording. Unverified suggestions show only in debug builds.

morning.title: One small intention
morning.text: Choose one small, kind thing to do for yourself today. Write it down so it stays with you.

morning.title: A one-minute breath
morning.text: Before the day gets busy, take one slow minute with the cat.

morning.title: Start softly
morning.text: Notice three things you can see from where you are. Then begin your day.

morning.title: Name one hope
morning.text: What would make today feel a little lighter? Note it in your journal.

afternoon.title: A stretch break
afternoon.text: Stand up, roll your shoulders, and take three slow breaths with the cat.

afternoon.title: Come back to now
afternoon.text: Feeling scattered? Try 5-4-3-2-1 to settle into this moment.

afternoon.title: A pause between tasks
afternoon.text: Look away from your screen for a minute and let your breath out slowly.

afternoon.title: Listen for a moment
afternoon.text: Name the sounds you can hear right now, near and far. Then carry on gently.

evening.title: What went well?
evening.text: Write down one thing that went okay today, however small.

evening.title: Leave it for tomorrow
evening.text: Note one thing you can put down for tonight. It can wait until morning.

evening.title: A kind word for you
evening.text: What would you say to a friend who had your day? Write it to yourself.

evening.title: If today felt heavy
evening.text: This short guide has a few gentle ideas for low days.

night.title: Slow breathing with the cat
night.text: Breathe slowly with the cat for a few minutes. Let your shoulders drop.

night.title: A longer breath out
night.text: Breathe in gently, then let the breath out a little longer. The cat will keep the pace.

night.title: Settle into your bed
night.text: If your thoughts keep turning, notice five things you can feel, like the pillow or the blanket.

night.title: Put it on paper
night.text: Write down what is on your mind, so it can wait until the morning.
